name: update_pull_request_review_thread
description: Resolve or reopen a review thread by thread ID.

owner.description: Origin namespace (owner) slug, taken from list_namespaces or an earlier Origin result. A GitHub owner or org name is not an Origin namespace unless list_namespaces returns it.

name.description: Origin repository name within that namespace

threadId.description: Thread to resolve or reopen, from threadId on pull_request_read comments

resolved.description: True resolves the thread; false reopens it
